title: Nissan Shuts Down System Used for Repairs After Hack Attempt
summary: The outage, which began a week ago, could delay repairs involving vehicle electronics and key fobs.
caption: Nissan said in a statement that it had “identified unauthorized access to part of a vehicle diagnostic system used by our dealers globally.”

title: The Internet Broke Our Taste. Will A.I. Destroy It for Good?
summary: In a world of slop capitalism, vibe-crafted culture and taste paranoia, why we like what we like feels harder than ever to know.

title: Trump Threatens to Bar U.S. Tech Firms From Building Data Centers Abroad
summary: The president suggested he would tax the same companies, though it was not clear how he would carry out the plan unveiled at a news conference.
caption: President Trump raised the prospect of imposing “tremendous penalties” on companies that tried to build data centers outside the United States.
